text: The authors cite Khan et al. (2024) among the few studies of debate's practical effectiveness and say the data are limited: most experiments use QuALITY and simple debate protocols with low recursive depth. They list open questions these studies do not settle, such as whether training reaches equilibrium and whether obfuscated arguments emerge.
title: Buhl et al. say evidence like Khan et al.'s QuALITY debate results is too limited for a safety case
